sre-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: multigpu collective stall detected on cluster 'orion' (region-us-west). Pager: @alice

alice: seeing repeated 'rendezvous timed out' in runtime logs, jobs stuck in PV rendezvous loop. p99 tokens spiking. Investigating.

jess: any CUDA Xid logs? could be driver or rogue kernel

alice: grabbing node logs, running `journalctl -u rw-runtime -n 200` and `nvidia-smi -q` now

alice: nvidia-smi shows one GPU with Compute Processes stuck and high ECC errors. stdout snippet:
```
NVRM: Xid (13) at ...
GPU 2: Compute Process  pid=14782, GPU Memory=95%
```

ben: k8s pod on node gpu-34 is OOM killing the runtime container repeatedly, restarts cause communicator mismatch. suspect NCCL communicator not tearing down cleanly.

morgan: throwing `NCCL WARN` in logs?

alice: yes: `NCCL WARN Connection timed out / rendezvous (120s) / communicator 0x7f8b3... reset` and then `nccl-net: failed send` across hosts

ops-bot: ACTIONS: Marking node gpu-34 as DRAINING. Removing new scheduling. Escalating to infra.

alice: mitigation attempt 1: restarted runtime container on gpu-34, didn't clear KV cache; collective still stuck. Logs show stale UCX endpoints.

morgan: mitigation attempt 2: set env on service to `NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SHARED` and restarted route to fallback single-gpu replica for the model (scale down TP to 1). Rolling now.

alice: scaling to single-gpu reduced error rate but p99 latency increased; traffic diversion to fallback route successful. Customer impact limited to higher latency and a few 500s during cutover.

customer-success: CS inbound: 8 customers reported intermittent failures, highest impact on customer-acct-821. Notifying accounts.

ben: while trying to fully recover, found `/var/log/rw-runtime/nccl.log` with repeating `communicator mismatch` lines. Posting snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] NCCL ERROR Comm 0x7f8b3: recv timeout on rank 3
[2026-03-15T14:03:02Z] NCCL INFO Attempting communicator reset
[2026-03-15T14:03:05Z] NCCL ERROR Communicator create failed: mismatch participants
```

morgan: root cause hypothesis: a pipeline-parallel job had uneven worker restarts leading to rendezvous participants diverging; combined with a GPU driver Xid causing one rank to stall and never respond, that left NCCL in a half-open collective.

jess: temporary remediation: add liveness probe to detect hung ranks earlier and trigger graceful drain before communicator leak. Long term: add rendezvous/heartbeat timeout tuning + pre-emptive rank fencing.

alice: I ran `kubectl cordon gpu-34 && echo "SYNC DRAIN" > /var/run/rw-runtime/maintenance` then `systemctl restart rw-runtime` after evacuating pods; recovered cleanly. Traffic back to normal. Will keep node offline for deeper driver diagnostics.

ops-bot: NOTE: Node gpu-34 marked MAINTENANCE; autoscaler launched replacement node gpu-78 to handle remaining capacity.

datadog-bot: Alert cleared 00:39 after mitigation. Metric: collective_fail_rate returned to baseline.

morgan: post-incident tasks: file driver support ticket (include Xid logs), add test to simulate rank eviction during TP rendezvous, update runbook with `NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING` guidance, tighten liveness probes for TP jobs.

alice: handing off to ben for follow-up and customer comms. @ben please own driver ticket and schedule maintenance.

ben: ack. I'll coordinate with infra for kernel/driver downgrade and reopen if errors reappear. Will post ETA.

sre-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: root message timestamp 2698765432. Duration 36m. Follow-up channel: #postmortems
